_about: Proposal at the Spring (m1), drafts by Claude for the user to edit. PA: she takes the Blue Feather (love 80+, chapter 1, no fiancee yet); PN: love under 80; PT: already engaged to someone else (or past chapter 1); SF: a Harvest Sprite gives you a Blue Feather (after the summoning, chapter 1, her love 80+, no fiancee and no feather).

lines.PA:
A Blue Feather...?
For me?

You know what this
means, don't you,
<name>?

...Yes. I'll marry
you.

But you'd better
treat me like a
princess. Promise!
lines.PN:
A Blue Feather...

Ask me again once
you know me a
little better.
lines.PT:
You've already
promised yourself to
someone, haven't you?

Hmph. Go on, then.
I'll be fine.
lines.SF:
The goddess is awake
and she likes you,
<name>!

Here, take this
Blue Feather.

If you give it to her
at the Spring... hee
hee, you'll see~
